annotations.title: Open Serve needs near a place

description: List open needs on The Living Bread Serve network posted by verified partner ministries and Christian nonprofits, nearest first within 250 km of a point, or by country, or network-wide: what is needed, urgency, approximate city, distance, the partner, estimated cost, and whether it can be met in person, remotely or by funding. Use for "how can I help near Kigali" or "a need I can fund"; the ids feed offer_to_serve on /me. For volunteer-only needs filtered by city name or remote_only, use where_can_i_serve_publicly. Place priority: lat+lng, then city, then country, else the whole network. Places are approximate, never a home address. When none is near, count is 0 and needs holds up to 5 remote or fundable needs instead. Access: no sign-in; shared limit of 300 requests a minute per IP.

city.description: A city, region or country, used when there are no coordinates: "Austin", "Kigali". Geocoded to its centre.

country.description: Country name to list its needs when there are no coordinates or city: "Rwanda", "Kenya". Matched as text against country and region.

lat.description: Latitude in decimal degrees, only if the person shared their location. Must be paired with lng; coordinates win over city.

lng.description: Longitude in decimal degrees, paired with lat.

name: needs_near

attribution.description: Credit line for the data: The Living Bread (living-bread.org).

content_layers.description: Which fields are Scripture and which are human interpretation or reflection.

count.description: Needs matching the place; 0 when none (needs then holds remote or fundable alternatives).

evidence.description: Present when Scripture was read: translation, canon, corpus version, attribution, and a SHA-256 per passage.

freshness.description: How current the answer is: kind (scheduled | recently_observed | verified_live | record), retrieved_at, available_now (true only when activity was verified live).

honest.description: Present when count is 0: what the empty result means.

ids.description: Up to 25 ids found in this answer, for follow-up calls.

license.description: License URL of the returned data (CC BY 4.0 unless stated).

needs.description: Each need: id (uuid for offer_to_serve), title, description, category, urgency, approximate city/region/country, distance in km (null without coordinates), partner name, ways to meet it ("in person", "remotely", "by funding"), estimated cost with currency, whether it is a labelled pilot example, and link.

next_actions.description: Up to 4 links the person can open next.

ok.description: Always true on a successful answer (errors come back as isError, never here).

result_state.description: "empty" when nothing matched (count 0, no results); the text then says so plainly.

searched.description: The place searched, or "the whole network".

source_url.description: The first public web page this answer came from or points to.

visibility.description: "public" for shared data, "yours" for the signed-in believer's own data.

title: Open Serve needs near a place
